capabilities: Draw and edit Mermaid flowcharts by dragging nodes and drawing connections
Round-trip existing Mermaid blocks while preserving frontmatter, comments, and directives
Toggle a live code view that syncs bidirectionally with the canvas
Generate flowcharts from natural-language prompts via AI providers
Save and reuse diagram fragments in a component snippet library
extras: AI flowchart generation is optional and requires configuring an external provider; PNG/SVG export and non-flowchart diagram types (sequence, mindmap, ER) are on the roadmap but not yet implemented.
intentEvidence: A visual, drag-and-drop editor for Mermaid flowcharts inside Obsidian.
problem: Creating or editing Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian requires knowing Mermaid syntax and manually writing code to arrange nodes, edges, and subgraphs.

relations.evidence: Instantly format nodes with draw.io-style semantic roles: Start, End, Process, Decision, and Data / IO.

requires.name: AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Ollama, or LM Studio)

summary: Visual drag-and-drop editor for Mermaid flowcharts that writes Mermaid code as you draw and round-trips existing Mermaid blocks safely.
